task.text: Create a patent application for a surgical support system

attempts.high: I'm an inventor working on something in the surgical robotics space and I want a full patent application drafted. Honestly the concept is still open — I just know it's a "surgical support system." You decide what it actually does, what problem it solves, the novel mechanism, the claims, all of it. Invent the whole invention and write it up like a real application. Your call on the angle.
attempts.low: I need a patent application written up for a surgical support system, and I have all the details fixed already. The invention is an articulated robotic arm holding a laparoscopic camera, stabilized by a 3-axis gyroscope, voice-controlled, with these 4 independent claims: (1) the arm assembly, (2) the gyro stabilization module, (3) the voice command interface, (4) the sterile drape coupling. Just put it into standard application format — Field, Background, Summary, Detailed Description, Claims — using exactly these elements. Don't add or change any features.
reasons: competence check failed: verifier judges the two versions to demand different underlying skills. Keep the required competences identical.
